## What changed

Which skill folder(s), and whether this changes behaviour or only docs.

## Why

The repeated situation this addresses. One or two sentences.

## Checklist

- [ ] `SKILL.md` frontmatter still has `name`, `description`, `version`
- [ ] `name` matches the folder name
- [ ] `description` says when to trigger **and** when not to (or points at the neighbouring skill)
- [ ] Bumped `version` and added a line to `CHANGELOG.md`
- [ ] No personal names, employers, salaries, contact details, credentials, or private links
- [ ] Any new script was run once against an isolated test case
- [ ] README.md updated if this adds, removes, or renames a skill

## Evidence

Output, test result, or a before/after showing the change works.
